assumptions: Flat JSON array — no folder hierarchy; all 100 messages are top-level elements.

Owner email is melon@spacey.com; messages where to=melon@spacey.com are incoming. Two messages (m058, m085) are outgoing (from=melon@spacey.com). Two self-sent (m070, m099) where from==to==melon@spacey.com.
Timestamps are ISO 8601 without timezone (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS); assumed to be owner's local timezone. No conversion performed.
Thread membership is by thread_id field only — no Message-ID, In-Reply-To, or References headers. Three threads have >1 message: t-infra (4), t-invest (2), t-launch (9).
unread is a status flag, not a processing gate; all 100 messages are processed for disposition regardless of read state.
Sender identity is the from field alone; no DKIM/SPF verification. Phishing messages spoof or mimic known correspondents (e.g. gwynne.nair@spacey.co vs real gwynne@spacey.com).
